card.name: Punctuation and links inside warning lists
card.fires_on: Commas, small linking words and word starts inside fixed warning sentences in NSAID and fluoroquinolone labels, such as the comma after 'swelling' in tendon-rupture symptoms or 'for' after 'monitor patients'.

modes.label: Commas in symptom lists
modes.description: The comma between listed symptoms in the tendon pain, swelling, inflammation or rupture warning.
modes.example: Discontinue BAXDELA immediately if the patient experiences pain, swelling<<,>> inflammation or rupture of a tendon.

modes.label: Linking words after patients or sensitivity
modes.description: A short word like 'for' or 'of' that leads into the next phrase in a monitoring or elderly-sensitivity sentence.

modes.label: Partway through NSAID terms
modes.description: The start or middle of a drug or physiology term such as probenecid, platelet aggregation or prostaglandin.
modes.example: NSAIDs inhibit platelet<< aggregation>> and have been shown to prolong bleeding time
